What is this site?

This site is a minimally-modified Astro write-up starter template. I'm using it to make my vulnhub write-ups easily navigable, and to give myself an ongoing project.

At the moment, the site is very basic. It shows my recent write-ups on a page, and then displays them the default template layout. I plan to add more features, such as a search box, filtering based off series and difficulty, and more displayed information when browsing the write-ups.

Here are a few ideas on how to get started with the template:

  • Edit this page in src/pages/index.astro
  • Edit the site header items in src/components/Header.astro
  • Add your name to the footer in src/components/Footer.astro
  • Check out the included write-ups in src/content/write-ups/
  • Customize the write-up page layout in src/layouts/write-up.astro
